_about: Phone-only short versions of long paragraphs. Each entry: the page, the opening words of the original paragraph (it stays the source, one tap away under Read more), and the short version. 'title' entries read as a row heading.

items.short: 11 universities founded the consortium through their teaching and learning centres. Together they share these roles:
Build and run the consortium website
Set the vision, mission and roadmap
Choose the priorities for the next 2–3 years
Run joint events: workshops, seminars, conferences
Do shared research on teaching and technology
The General Assembly elects the Board. The Board sets the consortium's plans and policies and represents it at outside events.
How to build AI skills into program and course outcomes, grow them through the degree, and check them in assessment.

items.short: Simple, inclusive teaching strategies based on neurodiversity and Universal Design for Learning that help every student.
